top_stories.title: ByteDance study finds that asking LMMs questions beats making it transcribe text for long document training
top_stories.summary: ByteDance Seed shows that a 7B model can answer questions on long, image-heavy documents more reliably than much larger models, even when documents are four times longer than anything it saw during training. top_stories.title: Why you shouldn't leave model selection on default in Copilot, Gemini and other AI tools
top_stories.summary: When analyzing data, Microsoft Copilot invents country differences where none exist. top_stories.title: These Robots Are Making Meals for a Nonprofit in San Francisco’s Tenderloin
top_stories.summary: A nonprofit in the city’s most troubled district has turned to robotic meal prep tech to make up for a dearth of human volunteers.
top_stories.technical_takeaway: Signals incremental evolution rather than a paradigm shift in current AI systems.
top_stories.primary_risk: Unclear production readiness despite promising early results.
